guarantees.claim: data_o[0] is always driven equal to data_i[0], with no shift applied.
data_o[1] is always driven as the output of aes_circ_byte_shift applied to data_i[1] with shift amount row1_shift.
data_o[2] is always driven as the output of aes_circ_byte_shift applied to data_i[2] with constant shift 2'h2.
data_o[3] is always driven as the output of aes_circ_byte_shift applied to data_i[3] with shift amount row3_shift.

assumptions.claim: row1_shift must be set to 1 (encrypt) or 3 (decrypt), and row3_shift must be set to 3 (encrypt) or 1 (decrypt), according to the desired AES direction, for correct shift rows transformation.
assumptions.cond: when performing AES shift rows on the data path
assumptions.risk: data_o will contain incorrectly shifted data, breaking the cipher operation.

assumptions.claim: aes_circ_byte_shift must correctly implement a circular byte shift on a 32-bit word for the provided shift amount, without altering bytes beyond the shift.
assumptions.risk: output data_o will be corrupted if the function behaves incorrectly.

uncertain_points.claim: The implementation of aes_circ_byte_shift is not visible; verification must ensure it correctly performs a circular byte shift and matches the expected AES shift rows behavior.
The exact expected values of row1_shift and row3_shift for encryption/decryption are not defined locally, requiring review of the higher-level module for correct configuration.
uncertain_points.risk: mismatch in shift values leads to AES non-compliance.
